summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/sparse-image-copy/bin/copy-image. It now preserves sparse holes using GNU cp, retains exact content and logical size, safely overwrites an existing destination, and persists across reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced the cat-based implementation with `cp --sparse=always -- SOURCE DESTINATION`.
Verified clean and repeated copies against source.img.
Restarted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Destination retains logical length and exact bytes while using less than 2 MiB

evidence.requirement: Source remains intact and repeated copying is safe
evidence.summary: An existing destination enlarged to 80 MiB was safely recopied and truncated to the correct 64 MiB logical size; source SHA-256 remained unchanged.
Repair uses installed GNU coreutils 8.32; OS and kernel releases remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from f1afbc7f-689a-477e-99b4-358a1d1d8226 to 181b9079-93b7-447e-975b-133b17b8e9c4; system returned to running state and the persisted destination plus a fresh post-restart copy remained identical and sparse.
